description.subtitle: Arsenal 2025 2026 Adidas Long Training Pants - Navy
description.tagline: Get ready to perform like the professionals
description.intro: Train in style with the adidas Arsenal pants for the 2025/2026 season. Its technical design offers comfort, freedom of movement and breathability even during intense sessions. Ideal for Arsenal fans and players looking for a modern and functional look.
key_benefits: Professional inspiration: Same style that players use in training.
Total comfort: Soft and elastic technical fabric for a perfect fit.
Optimal ventilation: Breathable technology to keep you dry.
Premium details: Embroidered logos and elegant finish.
Versatile use: Perfect for training or dressing casually.
